text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Omnimon] in text or w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ [All Turns] When your Digimon or Tamers are played or digivolve, if any of them have [Greymon] or [Matt Ishida] in their names, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
